name: LibreNMS Docker
what_it_is: A containerized deployment of LibreNMS, an auto-discovering PHP/MySQL/SNMP network monitoring system that supports 100+ vendors including Cisco, Juniper, and HP. It runs as a non-root user in multi-platform Docker containers using s6-overlay as the process supervisor.
components: librenms (PHP-FPM application + Nginx web UI on port 8000)
syslogng sidecar (syslog collection on port 514 TCP/UDP)
snmptrapd sidecar (SNMP trap receiver on port 162 TCP/UDP)
configuration: DB_HOST, DB_NAME, DB_USER, DB_PASSWORD, DB_TIMEOUT — database connection
REDIS_HOST — Redis endpoint for cache and session
CACHE_DRIVER, SESSION_DRIVER — storage backend (file, database, redis)
MEMORY_LIMIT, MAX_INPUT_VARS, UPLOAD_MAX_SIZE, OPCACHE_MEM_SIZE — PHP tuning
REAL_IP_FROM, REAL_IP_HEADER, LOG_IP_VAR — reverse proxy / IP handling
DISPATCHER_NODE_ID — identifies each dispatcher node in multi-dispatcher setup
SIDECAR_DISPATCHER, SIDECAR_SYSLOGNG, SIDECAR_SNMPTRAPD — activates sidecar mode per container
LIBRENMS_WEATHERMAP, LIBRENMS_WEATHERMAP_SCHEDULE — optional network weathermap plugin
TZ, PUID, PGID — timezone and file ownership
modes: Standalone (single librenms container with built-in poller)
Multi-dispatcher (librenms + one or more dispatcher sidecars coordinated via Redis)
Sidecar pattern (separate containers for syslog-ng and snmptrapd)
constraints: At least one dispatcher sidecar is required for polling to run in multi-dispatcher mode
Redis is mandatory for multi-dispatcher deployments (dispatcher coordination)
MariaDB 10 is the documented database; MySQL compatibility implied but not the primary target
Volume ownership must be correctly set (PUID/PGID) or the application fails to start
NET_ADMIN and NET_RAW Linux capabilities are required on each librenms container
All sidecar containers (dispatcher, syslogng, snmptrapd) share the same /data volume as the main container
notable_absences: No built-in packet capture or flow (NetFlow/sFlow/IPFIX) collection
No streaming telemetry collector (gNMI/gRPC) in the compose example
No Grafana or external visualization layer included
No built-in TFTP/FTP server for device config backup
No agent-based monitoring (relies solely on SNMP and syslog)
